desc: The Wheeler 30-Piece P-Handle Driver Set has a sleek molded stand design paired with its ability to be mounted on the wall allow for quick, convenient access. The molded stand can sit on bench top or has mounting holes on back for hanging. SAE Hex (3/32, 7/61, 1/8 ball, 9/64 ball, 5/32 ball, 3/16 ball, 7/32 ball, 1/4 ball, 5/16 ball, 3/8 ball) Metric Hex (1.5mm, 2mm ball, 2.5mm ball, 3mm ball, 4mm ball, 5mm ball, 6mm ball, 7mm ball, 8mm ball and 10mm ball) Torx (T7, T8, T9, T10, T15, T20, T25, T27, T30 and T40).
